A systematic literature review focusing on intentional weight loss in healthy men and women, rather than weight cycling per se,
identiﬁed nine studies that could address this issue. The review yielded no consistent evidence that intentional weight loss either
increased or decreased mortality. Simonsen concluded that it is still not possible to make secure recommendations that intentional
weight loss will increase longevity. This is in contrast to research on severely obese bariatric surgery patients showing improved
